name: Zisha slab building
summary: A hand method to build a thin-walled teapot from beaten slabs and strips of zisha clay, with no wheel and no mould.
how: Beat the clay into a flat slab of 2 to 4 mm.
Cut a base and a strip for the wall and wrap them round a form.
Scrape the wall smooth with a steel scraper and a bamboo knife.
Grind the lid to fit the mouth with no gap.

origin.note: Yixing potters build small unglazed teapots by hand, as steeped tea replaces whisked tea.

adoptions.via: Yixing potters build every pot by hand from slabs and strips, and stamp it with a seal.
